purpose: User-provided live shortlist rebuilt ENTIRELY from the authoritative 16-row CSV (candidates.csv, user-declared source of truth 2026-07-20). Replaces all prior candidate data. Descriptors keep the seller's original Chinese wording plus English glosses for lexicon matching; glosses add no new claims.
curation_notes: Source: candidates.csv (16 rows), user said '用这份 cvs 数据, 这个是准确的' (2026-07-20). Every candidate maps 1:1 to a CSV row.

Two data errors from the prior list are corrected here: Santamaria Estate altitude is BLANK per the label (prior invented '1550-1950'); Acacia Pacamara flavor is 'Tropical soursop 刺果番荔枝' (prior wrote 'lychee').

Roaster stored short (Subtext/FriedHats/Hatch/Mirra/Tanat) to match rated-history spelling for the roaster-affinity bonus; roaster_full keeps the CSV's full name incl. country. Tanat = Tanat Coffee / Kawa Coffee (France).
Two candidates are also rated history (both Great, 复购型已知好豆): live_friedhats_las_margaritas_sudan_rume and live_tanat_las_margaritas_sudan_rume_natural. Kept as candidates, flagged — not dropped.
Seller: all 16 are listed via Urlicht Coffee / 原光咖啡 (转售/代购渠道).

accolades: structured competition/quality provenance (Copa de Oro, COE, Tanzania PCA). Extrinsic, human-judgment only — NOT scored by candidate_prior. Same stance as region/estate reputation: recorded, not fed into fit.

provenance_reputation: estate/region tags from references/prestige-regions-estates.md (Tier 1 estate, Tier 2-B estate, Tier 2-A region allowlist). Also extrinsic, scored:false. Unlisted origins/estates carry an empty list = null (the normal state, not a demerit). Note CGLE farms sit in Valle del Cauca, which is NOT an A-list department, so those carry an estate tag but no region tag.
